all.name: Venom
all.description: Using his symbiote-enhanced body as the perfect living weapon, Eddie Brock and his alien ally stand ever-ready to unleash vicious attacks upon anyone he deems an enemy. Those ensnared by Venom's tentacles have no choice but to surrender to this insatiable predator.

item.name: Alien Biology
item.description: PRESS{Jump} to wall crawl, and while crawling, PRESS{PrimaryAttack}to sprint.

item.name: Dark Predation
item.description: Unleash tentacles forward to attack enemies.

additional_fields.Attack_Interval: 0.9s, with a 0.1s interval between each tendril

item.name: Frenzied Arrival
item.description: Dash to the target location from a certain height. Upon landing, damage nearby enemies, <Debuff>Launching Them Up</> towards the landing point.

additional_fields.Damage: 65 damage, with damage falloff starting at 2m from the center of the spell field and decreasing to 40% at 6m
additional_fields.Special_Effect: Knocks enemies inward, with an inward knockback angle of 75°

item.name: Cellular Corrosion
item.description: Unleash tentacles to <Debuff>Slow</> enemies within reach. Enemies unable to break free in time will suffer damage.

additional_fields.Damage: The spell field deals 5 damage, increasing to 80 damage if the target remains in the area for a duration
additional_fields.Casting: Spell field that surrounds the caster
additional_fields.Special_Effect: Tendrils apply a 25% Slow on the target and take 3s to inflict damage. If the distance from Venom exceeds 11m, the tendrils will detach

item.name: Venom Swing
item.description: Launch webbing forward, allowing for a singular swing in the desired direction.

item.name: Symbiotic Resilience
item.description: Generate <Buff>Bonus Health</> against damage. The lower Venom's Health, the greater the <Buff>Bonus Health</> generated.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: Grant 100 Bonus Health and convert 120% of lost Health into Bonus Health

item.name: Feast Of The Abyss
item.description: Burrow underground for free movement. After a duration or by pressing {PrimaryAttack}, devour enemies above to deal damage based on the enemy's current health and generate equivalent <Buff>Bonus Health</>. Devoured enemies suffer <Debuff>Reduced Healing</>.

additional_fields.Damage: Inflict damage equal to 50% of the target's health, followed by an additional 50 damage
additional_fields.Casting: Single-cast spell field that surrounds the caster
additional_fields.Special_Effect: 130% of damage dealt is converted into Bonus Health
